address_rewrites.note: Build 0159/OPEN-017: pass-sequence table base pointer relocation. `move.l #0x00050F6B, %d0` at arcade 0x0503CE loads the PC080SN pass-sequence table base into a DATA register; the postpatch shift-relocation only shifts abs.l control-transfer/LEA operands, so this data-register immediate was NOT relocated +0x200 (its sibling `movea.l #0x00050EE0, %a1` at 0x0503BC WAS, -> 0x000510E0). On Genesis the un-relocated pointer reads ROM[0x050F6B]=0x80 instead of the correct relocated ROM[0x05116B]=0x00 (arcade ROM[0x050F6B]=0x00), so a5@0x10C6 lands 0x200 too low and the desc-rebuild sets the tilemap PASS SELECTOR a5@0x10A8=0x0080 (FG) instead of 0x0000 (BG). Arcade always selects BG (a5@0x10A8==0) for the Stage 1 collision/tilemap pass. Fix relocates ONLY this data-register immediate 0x00050F6B -> 0x0005116B (byte-neutral, opcode 0x203C preserved; movel #imm,Dn is not in the shift-adjust set so the replacement is not re-shifted). No NOP, no destination patch, no forced value, no collision emission, no 0x10DE00 rebase. Same missed-data-register-literal class as Build 0158 (0x05102E).

Runtime 0x03D24C (arcade 0x03D04C) issues `move.w %d1, 0x00C08C66` where d1 = digit tile 0x30..0x39 (= 9 - d0 + 0x30) -- a raw PC080SN FG C-window store that strict-target emulators fault on (user report: BlastEm strict-freeze at write address C08C66 during gameplay). Now routed through genesistan_hook_inline_fg_write_3d04c -> genesistan_hook_tilemap_fg_fill live LUT (digit tiles 0x30..0x39 already LUT-mapped). Wrapper stages one FG cell at base 0x00C08C64 (code word at +2), preserves d0-d7/a0-a6, and reproduces the original MOVE.W N/Z/V/C via tst.w d1. Build 0158/OPEN-017/KF-036/KF-039: single-site raw work-RAM literal rebase. `move.w 0x0010C016, %d0` reads the Stage 1 command source from the ABSOLUTE arcade work-RAM literal 0x0010C016 (not an instruction-operand shape the postpatch relocation rewrites). On Genesis that literal is a ROM address holding 0x5553, so runtime 0x05122E loads garbage and the next store (0x05122E+6 = runtime 0x051234, `move.w %d0, a5@0x137A`) writes 0x5553 to a5+0x137A instead of the arcade's 0x00FF. The command value IS correctly present in mapped work RAM: Genesis 0x00FF0016 holds 0x00FF (matching arcade WRAM 0x10C016=0x00FF), written by 0x03A99A (arcade 0x03A79A) at command time. Classification A (correct value at 0x00FF0016, copied reader reads raw 0x10C016). Fix rebases ONLY this reader's absolute operand 0x0010C016 -> 0x00FF0016 via arcade base 0x0010C000 -> Genesis 0x00FF0000 (KF-039). Byte-neutral opcode_replace (6->6, opcode 0x3039 preserved); no NOP, no destination patch, no forced value, no seed, no fallback, no ROM-wide rebase. Validation: runtime 0x051234 now writes 0x00FF to 0x00FF137A; the 0x5553 command is gone; command tracks arcade through drop/landing.

Route PC080SN FG strip producer through rastan-direct hook symbol at 0x055990. Build 0155/OPEN-017: genesistan_hook_tilemap_fg (0x703EA) is the LIVE Stage 1 FG boundary. The arcade FG producer 0x055968->0x070248 (plane_a) is dynamically bypassed on Genesis (KF-040 class); instead the Stage 1 setup loop (0x50634) calls the dispatcher 0x055B48, which (a5@0x10A8=0x80 != 0) routes to THIS hook once per FG column. Its native slot a5@0x10A4 is out of the FG C-window so it bails, while the real FG column dest is a5@0x10A0 = 0xC08000 + dcol*4. A Build 0155 preamble (gated on genesistan_current_scene_id==1) replays the proven FG model directly from ROM: SRC=0x16B1C+seg*0x22C0+group*4 (arcade 0x1691C + copy 0x200), block=ROM_word(SRC+2)+0x200, code=ROM_word(block+colidx*2+row*8), attr=0x0003; dcol=(a5@0x10A0&0x3FFC)>>2, group=dcol>>2, colidx=dcol&3, planerow=seg*4+row. Stages the visible top 32 rows (seg 0..7; fg_fill's 32-row buffer wraps seg 8..15) via genesistan_hook_tilemap_fg_fill -> staged_fg_buffer -> fg_row_dirty -> existing FG VBlank commit. fg_fill preserves d0-d7/a0-a6; the preamble uses d0-d6/a0/a2/a4 which fg_fill restores; CCR not caller-observed here. FG tile family (49 codes, 48 non-blank + transparent 0x020->tile 0/blank slot 0) added to the global LUT + gameplay manifest by precompute_pc080sn_tile_lut.py:collect_runtime_gameplay_fg_tiles. Validation: Genesis MAME 2/3/0 staged_fg 76->2020/2048, visible rows 0-27 match arcade FG cells 98%, Plane B unchanged, frontend intact, deterministic. Non-gameplay scenes fall through to the unchanged FG descriptor path.
